d:
A teddy bear species with a split color scheme, the right side is snowy white and the left side is charcoal black. The right eye is a simple black bead, while the left eye is a menacing red spiral. It has a round body with short limbs and three sharp claws on each paw. It wears a fuse-lit bomb as a hat and carries a detonator.
BODY COLOR: snowy white and charcoal black
